proof.trust_boundary: The registry record has no offline-verifiable signature; authenticity requires independent human verification.

chronology_contract.timezone_rule: Every timestamp must be finite ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset.
chronology_contract.identity_rule: provider, identifier, verification_uri, registered_at, and registered_artifact_sha256 must agree with the retained provider record.

human_trust_boundary: When no offline-verifiable provider signature or inclusion proof exists, the manifest hash establishes artifact identity but not timestamp authenticity. A named human verifier must inspect the provider-controlled record, preserve and hash the evidence, and accept responsibility for that verification.
completion_gate: Do not populate this template unless an external provider has actually accepted the exact design-manifest artifact. Null, placeholder, unverified, or self-issued evidence cannot authorize execution.
